title: Network and cookie jar
brief: Network settings (custom CA bundle, client certificates with keyring passphrases, proxy system/none/manual with keyring password and bypass, per-workspace proxy override, skipped-entry warnings with no secret) and the per-workspace cookie jar (list, filter, delete one, clear all with confirm, empty state, where it opens from). Built on the bolt-v2 shell with a states desk; only what reqflux_engine backs: [network] is read-only (no config writer yet), keyring secrets show set or not set.

artboards.title: Settings page sections
artboards.tradeoff: Fits the chosen settings page (app-settings/02): App > Network beside General and MCP policy, Workspace > Cookies beside Globals; each skipped entry is struck through in place with its warning. Shows config.toml as written, not what a given workspace ends up using, and the jar is a page away from the response that set the cookies

artboards.title: Network and Cookies document tabs
artboards.tradeoff: Shows what this workspace's sends use now (Engine::network_settings after the override), skipped entries in one banner, and the jar as a grid with an inspector next to the requests; a fourth settings surface outside the settings page, and the app-level proxy only shows as a note when a workspace overrides it
